description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different configurations of a language model (LLM) in solving math word problems, as measured by the CoLaG-R score, which is presented as a percentage on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis categorizes the LLM configurations into three groups: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. Each group contains four bars representing different configurations: no SFT (Self-Fitting Training), SFT on D0, SFT on D0, D1, and SFT on D0, D1, D2. The bars are color-coded and patterned to distinguish between the configurations. The CoLaG-R score ranges from 0 to 80%, with the scale marked at intervals of 10%. The chart shows that the LLaMA-2-70B configuration generally has the highest CoLaG-R scores across all configurations, with the highest score being just below 80%. The LLaMA-2-7B and LLaMA-2-13B configurations have similar scores, with the highest being around 70%. The chart does not provide specific numerical values for each bar, but the visual representation indicates that the LLaMA-2-70B configuration performs the best, followed by the LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-7B configurations.
